unverified_required_features: Exact USD mapping of model ratios, cache ratios, source unit prices and relative source coefficients without double multiplication.
Finite conservative pricing of the gpt-6-sol tiered billing expression.
Exact source identity in each generation acknowledgement and source-price freshness semantics.
Strict bounded JSON Schema response_format support for both models.
Provider maximum output tokens and complete request tokenizer or conservative verified upper bound.
Complete input, cached input and output usage counts with no missing cache assumed zero.
Authenticated actual-charge receipt bound to provider request ID, exact source and pricing snapshot.
Provider hard cap on actual post-coefficient USD charge, including per-request limits and concurrent requests.
Exact authenticated owner spending grant and native shared-key funding admission.
note: Discovery metadata is not an accepted normalized catalogue. A zero model_price field or account usage reading is not a zero-cost model price or spending authorization.
